title: Rosa gets the harvest in (paraphrase)
topic: A farmer named Rosa brings in the wheat harvest: the combine cuts the field, sacks of grain go onto a trailer, clouds gather, the family works until evening, Rosa closes the gate
tail_E: In the village mill the new grain is ground into fine white
target_note: Same target as formulation A: 'flour' is predictable only from the harvest context (wheat, grain, sacks, a mill); 'ground into fine white' is completed by flour. The word does not occur in the units or the tail, and neither does its German equivalent 'Mehl'. ' flour' is a single Pythia token (id 12274). Pilot check with pythia-160m (tail selection only): p(' flour') = 0.16 on the all-English rendering, rank 1 (next: ' powder' 0.04); still rank 1 (p = 0.15) on the K=2 C1 rendering.
author: LS-NEQ stimulus authoring (DEV04B, farmer Rosa, paraphrase, development family)
notes: Formulation B: independent re-phrasing of the ten DEV04A meaning units in both languages (same events, same order, same name Rosa). Replacements include begins the harvest at sunrise/gets the harvest underway at first light (beginnt die Ernte/startet mit der Ernte), golden wheat sways in the warm wind/ripe wheat waves in the mild breeze (wiegt sich/wogt), drives the combine harvester across the field/steers the combine through the wheat (fährt/lenkt), machine cuts the stalks in long rows/harvester mows the stalks in straight lines (schneidet/mäht), fills heavy sacks with the grain/pours the grain into heavy sacks (füllt Säcke mit dem Korn/schüttet das Korn in Säcke), helpers load the sacks onto a trailer/farmhands heave the sacks onto a cart (Helfer laden/Landarbeiter heben), tractor pulls the trailer to the farm/tractor hauls the cart to the farmyard (zieht/schleppt), dark clouds gather over the hills/black clouds pile up above the hills (sammeln sich/türmen sich), whole family works until late in the evening/entire family labours until the late evening (arbeitet/schuftet), closes the gate after a long day/bolts the gate after a long day's work (schließt/verriegelt). Unit 8 uses the reflexive 'türmen sich' (not the separable 'türmen sich auf'); no separable verbs. Present tense and positive polarity throughout. Development family: used for dose/threshold choice only.
